contract: HealthService: read-only observer. Per UTC hour it sums joins, player-minutes per level band, the most ready players on one server, gold in / out per source / sink and per band, XP per band (ProgressionService.XPEarned), the goose (rounds, Halo / Horns wins, ties, co-op, nobody paid; pay per player: GooseService.GooseRewarded) , plunder sacks (count / gold per outcome), pass view -> prompt -> bought. Sums tables hold at most 40 keys (+ Other), keys are cleaned, no name or id. Every FlushSeconds (x0.5..1.5) and at the close the unsaved sums are merged (UpdateAsync) into ONE document per UTC hour 'H<YYYYMMDDHH>' in Config.StoreName('HaloHorns_Health_v1') (Studio: _STUDIO); numbers added, Peak the larger, Servers counted once per server and hour; a failed write keeps the sums for the next flush; events during a write go to the next. DebugCommand('Health'[, 'stored' | 'live'[:hours]]) prints totals, rates per player-hour and ALERT lines (QUIET, SURGE of XP / gold per player-hour vs the earlier hours, GOOSE lopsided).
limitations: Real DataStore limits and throttling are not simulated (one UpdateAsync per hour per server per flush is far under them); the Studio command (DebugCommand) is wired by source (static). The alert numbers are starter values (Config.Health.Alerts) to tune after the first real tests.
